content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DHAS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Dr. Hedgewar Arogya Sansthan Delhi (DHAS Delhi) to fill vacant senior resident positions on an ad-hoc basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DHAS Delhi Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available across various specialties including Anaesthesia, Obs & Gynae, Medicine, and Radiology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for DHAS Delhi Senior Resident jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in Interview. Interested and eligible candidates need to report directly to the venue for registration and interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 30 September 2026. Candidates must complete their registration between 09:30 AM and 11:30 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for DHAS Delhi Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with a postgraduate Degree, Diploma, or DNB in the concerned specialty, along with a valid registration with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years for General category candidates. Age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and PWD candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What salary will selected candidates receive?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed at Level 11, receiving a salary scale of Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 along with admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No application fee has been prescribed or mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring photographs, photocopies of qualifying certificates, proof of date of birth, a valid Photo ID card, and address proof along with originals.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates check the official notification and updates?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official notification PDF and find complete details directly through the important links section provided in this article.
